summary: Design an enhanced ConvNeXt V2 architecture incorporating multi-scale dynamic convolutions, adaptive feature recalibration via a lightweight coordinate-aware gating mechanism, and a refined pretraining strategy (improved FCMAE with spatial-aware masking and hierarchical reconstruction loss) to improve representation quality and downstream performance while maintaining the pure-conv paradigm.
assumptions: The baseline is the published ConvNeXt V2 architecture with FCMAE pretraining and GRN layers at 4 scale variants (Atto to Large).
Improvements target ImageNet classification as the primary benchmark, with transfer learning to detection/segmentation as secondary validation.
Computational budget remains competitive with similarly sized ConvNeXt V2 and ViT variants (no extreme FLOP increases).
The design maintains a pure-convolutional pipeline without native self-attention, preserving ConvNet-friendly inference optimization.
